title: Pats-Seahawks SB rematch to kick off '26 season

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Pats-Seahawks SB rematch to kick off '26 season
sources.description: In a rematch of Super Bowl LX, the Seahawks will welcome the Patriots to Lumen Field for the 2026 NFL season opener, one of 272 games officially announced throughout the league Thursday night.
